name: research-mapper
description: Research Mapper — Paperscape-style arXiv paper search, citation graph builder, and research trend analysis
author: nsk

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search arXiv for research papers by query, category, or author. Returns structured paper data with titles, authors, abstracts, and citation graph.

tools.name: build_graph

tools.name: get_paper

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List popular arXiv research categories with descriptions.

prompts.name: research_topic
prompts.description: Guide the user through exploring a research topic on arXiv

resources.name: arXiv Categories
resources.description: List of arXiv research categories for filtering searches
